Town work, as authored data (REQ-TWN-007/009). A job says what makes a hunter good at it — never who is allowed to do it. `from` weights attributes, `roleLean` weights build identity's role axis, and both are inputs to the assignment score in ai/town/jobAssignment.ts alongside the hunter's own stated preferences (REQ-TWN-010, DL-008).

Slots are not defined here. A job exists as a kind of work; the number of people who can do it comes from the buildings actually standing in the town (buildings.json `jobs`), so a town with no smithy has forge work as a concept and nowhere to do it.

`output.food` and `output.materials` are authored now and consumed by the Phase 7 economy. Food is the exception: it feeds town capacity immediately, because REQ-TWN-003's food pressure would otherwise be unanswerable — a town could grow but never feed itself.
